strings.sys.server.title: Our servers are having trouble
strings.sys.server.body: Please try again in a moment. Your room is unchanged.
strings.sys.ai.title: Decorating is unavailable for now
strings.sys.ai.body: The day count and viewing the room still work. Please try again later.
strings.sys.login.title: Your sign-in has expired
strings.sys.login.body: Sign in again to pick up where you left off.
strings.sys.denied.title: You can't open this space
strings.sys.denied.body: You're not a member of this space, or it has ended.
strings.sys.old.title: This room was decorated in a newer app version
strings.sys.old.body: Update the app to see it all. For now you're seeing the parts this version can read.
strings.sys.asset.title: Some items couldn't be loaded
strings.sys.asset.body: The spots are left empty. They reload automatically when your connection improves.
strings.sys.pending.title: Waiting to sync
strings.sys.pending.body: It updates to the latest once you're connected.
strings.sys.quota.title: You've used all of today's tries
strings.sys.empty.title: Nothing to show yet
strings.sys.empty.body: Content will show up here once there is some.
